autoRead.delayHint: 0 marks a message read as soon as it opens.

notifications.showForNewMail: Show desktop notifications for new mail

push.title: Push (IMAP IDLE)
push.hint: When on, the app keeps a connection open for accounts whose server supports IDLE, so new mail arrives immediately instead of waiting for the next check. Accounts without it keep polling.
push.unavailable: Changing push needs the desktop app; it is unavailable in the browser preview.

junk.enable: Enable junk filter (score incoming mail and file spam automatically)
junk.thresholdHint: Mail scoring at or above this confidence is moved to Junk.
junk.trustHeaders: Trust server junk headers (honor X-Spam-Flag / X-Spam-Status)
junk.whitelist: Never mark mail from my contacts as junk
junk.markRead: Mark messages as read when they are filed as junk
junk.runHint: Re-scores every account's Inbox and files anything over the threshold.
junk.filedCount: Filed {count} message as junk. | Filed {count} messages as junk.
junk.unavailable: Junk settings need the desktop app; they are unavailable in the browser preview.
junk.runUnavailable: Running junk controls needs the desktop app; it is unavailable in the browser preview.

pop3.title: POP3 server deletion
pop3.warning: Deletes mail from the server after download. This cannot be undone.
pop3.unavailable: Changing the delete policy needs the desktop app; it is unavailable in the browser preview.

emptyTrash.title: Empty Trash on exit
emptyTrash.hint: Permanently deletes each selected account's Trash when the app closes.
emptyTrash.unavailable: Changing this setting needs the desktop app; it is unavailable in the browser preview.

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.hintBefore: These shortcuts work throughout axomail. Press
shortcuts.hintMiddle: anywhere to bring up this list, or
shortcuts.hintAfter: for the command palette. Custom rebinding is coming in a later update.

dialog.title: Settings
dialog.unavailable: Settings require the desktop app; they are unavailable in the browser preview.
dialog.saveUnavailable: Saving settings needs the desktop app; it is unavailable in the browser preview.
